presentation:
The5ers was founded in 2016 and trades as FIVE PERCENT ONLINE LTD, registered in Israel and in the United Kingdom. It is not regulated and does not provide financial services: it funds traders on its own capital, through commercial liquidity providers it does not name.

The firm says it employs 171 people across 24 countries, has onboarded 262,000 traders and opened more than 1.6 million trading accounts.

Four routes sit side by side. Pro Growth is a single evaluation phase. High Stakes is the two-step route, with the fee refunded in stages. Hyper Growth funds you from purchase and doubles the account at every 10% target. The futures line, launched separately, trades CME contracts on BlackArrow.

programmes.resume: Challenge then Verification, a static loss limit and no deadline. The fee comes back in stages: 10% in Hub Credits after step 1, 20% after step 2, 70% in cash with your first payout. NEW asks 10% in step 1, Classic asks 8%.
programmes.maxComptesNote: Classic: one account per size. NEW: up to three on the small sizes.

programmes.resume: A single evaluation phase: 10% target, a 6% static loss limit, a 3% daily loss and three profitable days worth at least 0.5% each.

programmes.resume: No evaluation at all. Hitting the daily limit pauses the account until midnight instead of closing it, and the balance doubles at every 10% target, up to $4,000,000.

programmes.resume: The balance grows at each step instead of staying flat, with a 6% target every time and no daily loss until you are funded. A stop-loss is mandatory within three minutes of entry, risking at most 2%.

programmes.resume: A 6% target with a 4% end-of-day trailing drawdown, no minimum days, and a consistency rule of 40% per position. Day Trade closes everything before the session ends; Swing keeps one mini overnight.

parcours.texte: One phase on Pro Growth and on futures, two on High Stakes, none on Hyper Growth. No time limit, and no monthly fee.
You trade the same limits with no profit target. KYC is required once you pass: identity and proof of address.
The first payout comes 14 days after the funded account opens, then every 14 days. Withdrawals carry a 3.5% fee, or none in Hub Credits.

CFD: $4 per forex lot round turn, nothing on indices, a percentage on metals, oil and crypto. Futures: $5.00 round turn on standard contracts, $2.50 on micros.

verdict.texte: Ten years in business, and the range best suited to swing trading: no deadline on any evaluation, a static drawdown instead of a trailing one, positions held overnight and over the weekend, and scaling that runs into the millions. Entry tickets start at $19, among the lowest on the market, and the catalogue covers every budget from $2,500 to $250,000 of capital. In exchange, every withdrawal costs 3.5%, the news window on High Stakes is strict to the minute, and the firm states plainly that it is not regulated and that the accounts are simulated.

titre: Ten years of funded trading, with no time limit
description: Founded in 2016, The5ers is one of the oldest CFD prop firms still trading. Four routes, from $2,500 to instant funding, plus a futures line launched in 2026.
